occurrences.raw_occurrenceRemarks: Both mother and baby appeared to have good body weight and healthy coats.  This is the 2nd sighting in 2 weeks.  The other was a young male on Settlers Way, relocated by the AMAZING volunteers from the Port Macquarie Koala Hospital.  The area between Kempsey and Crescent Head has always had koalas, with multiple sightings over the years, however this won't continue to be the case, unless Kempsey Shire Council stop approving the 'clear felling' of habitat for sub-divisions, and start enforcing tree preservation orders and wildlife corridors.
